name: nix-worktrees-hooks
description: Hooks that call the worktrees program in every session: SessionStart loads the worktree environment into every Bash command and sweeps the repository in the background, and SubagentStop and SessionEnd clean a finished agent's worktree; each does nothing when worktrees isn't on the PATH. PreToolUse on Bash refuses builds below the disk's build floor and all but cleanup below its cleanup floor.
